E4.purpose: Track C: popularity-aware reranking of the selected E2 MF (RQ1, RQ2)

selection_rules.E2: max validation ndcg@10; ties -> recall@10 -> fewer factors
selection_rules.E3: max validation ndcg@10; ties -> recall@10 -> smaller max_features -> ngram_max=1
selection_rules.E4: max long_tail_exposure@10 subject to ndcg@10 >= 0.95 * ndcg@10 of the selected E2 MF; ties -> catalog_coverage@10 -> smaller alpha+beta; the full alpha x beta grid is reported as the RQ2 trade-off curve
